reader_summary.headline: No matter how grand a vision for a particular industry, disruption in practice is hard.
reader_summary.overview: No matter how grand a vision for a particular industry, disruption in practice is hard. This is especially true in industries like healthcare, which have long been resistant to software-driven change. But sometimes you can innovate within the bounds of the industry.

key_points.text: But sometimes you can innovate within the bounds of the industry.
This conversation -- recorded at our recent a16z Summit in November 2017 -- between co-founder and CEO of Omada Health, Sean Duffy and CEO of Accolade.
As this generation of digital health tech companies begin to change the healthcare business -- and scale -- what effect are they having on the rising cost of heathcare overall.
